description: The client pastes the link of a 1688 product they want to buy: returns the `produit` reference of that product, to read its page, get its quote and order it. Free, no quota. Call it as soon as they give a 1688 link, before any other tool: do not search with the link.

lien.description: The 1688 link of the product, as they pasted it.
